UserPresence.title: UserPresence
UserPresence.description: Real-time online presence and last active status for a Coolerup account (without any PII or location).

uid.description: Authenticated user ID that owns this presence document.

handle.description: Normalized lowercase Coolerup handle for the account.

isOnline.description: Whether the user is currently active inside Coolerup.

lastActive.description: Server timestamp of the user's most recent activity or disconnect.

showOnline.description: Privacy flag ('Show when I'm online'). When false, status is hidden from others.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the presence document was first created.

/user_presence/{presenceId}.description: Stores live online/offline presence (isOnline, lastActive, showOnline) keyed by deterministic handle ID.
